description: This source file defines the ICustomStorageInterface interface for storage operations in the Orleans EventSourcing framework, including methods for reading state and applying updates.

classes.name: ICustomStorageInterface
classes.description: A generic interface for custom storage interactions in Orleans EventSourcing, enabling reading state and applying updates with version control.

methods.name: ReadStateFromStorage
methods.description: Asynchronously reads the current state and version from storage, returning a key-value pair of version number and state object.

methods.name: ApplyUpdatesToStorage
methods.description: Asynchronously applies a list of delta updates to storage if the current version matches the expected version, returning true if successful.
